title: Etale trivializations for one fixed finite constant model
statement: Let X be a scheme, Λ a finite commutative ring, M a fixed finite Λ-module, and F a pro-etale sheaf of Λ-modules. Suppose a scheme pro-etale covering W_i → X [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] trivializes the inverse image of F with the same constant model M on every member [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then there is an etale covering of X indexed in the universe of X, on each member of which F has constant module model M. The hypothesis imposes a single fixed model; it contains no geometric-stalk or comparison-origin assertion.

theorem etale_cover_of_proetale_uniform_model
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Finite M]
    (hF : ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (W : I → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ X),
      Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ proetalePrecoverage X ∧
        ∀ i, Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (g i)).obj F ≅
            (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (W i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (𝒰.f i)).obj F ≅
          (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (𝒰.X i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
